exercises.title: LabBook Milestone 9 — BDD Acceptance Tests for Release 2.0
exercises.problemHtml:
LabBook Project · Milestone 9 — BDD Acceptance Tests for Release 2.0

Running project · final milestone · Gherkin acceptance tests executed on LabBook and faulty builds · 10 marks

1. Overview

Last milestone. For release 2.0 the three amigos turn the booking rules into executable acceptance tests in Gherkin. The developers already wrote the step definitions (lib/steps.js, read-only); you write FEATURE. Supported steps:

Given the seed data is loaded              |  Given the clock is Monday 2026-11-02 08:00
When <actor> books <LAB> on <YYYY-MM-DD> at <hour> for <n> hour(s)
When <actor> cancels <BKnnnn>              |  When <actor> closes <LAB>  /  opens <LAB>
When <actor> logs in with the right / wrong password
When <actor> lists her / his / their bookings
When the admin locks <e-mail>  /  unlocks <e-mail>
Then the answer is <status> [CONFIRMED | PENDING | CANCELLED | OPEN | CLOSED | <ERROR_CODE>]   (checks the previous action)
Then the list contains <n> booking(s)        (checks the previous list)
Then <BKnnnn> is <CONFIRMED | PENDING | CANCELLED> in the database
actors: student1, student2, student3, manager, admin   ·   And / But continue the previous keyword

Each scenario starts from the LabBook seed data (LAB01 2 seats, LAB02 1 seat, LAB03 closed; codes BK0001… in creation order; clock Monday 2026-11-02 08:00). The rules are those of the LabBook API of chapters 2–8: own bookings only, no overlapping bookings in any lab, a 14-day window, locked accounts lose their tokens, no cancellation less than 2 hours before the start, only managers change labs, at most 6 hours a week (422 WEEKLY_LIMIT), re-opened labs accept bookings.

A. Write at least 6 scenarios. The grader runs them on LabBook and on 8 faulty builds (6 listed, 2 hidden). B. Describe your BDD practice in BDD.

Main features

  • A. A Gherkin feature of at least 6 scenarios that passes on LabBook and catches the faulty builds.
  • B. Who, when, which quadrant, what else.

General requirements

  • Write the expected behaviour from the rules, not from what you think the build does.

2. Required project structure

answers/
├── booking.feature.js   ← const FEATURE = `Feature: … Scenario: … Given … When … Then …`
├── bdd.js               ← const BDD = { scenariosWrittenBy, writtenWhen, quadrant, stillNeeded }
lib/
└── steps.js             ← step definitions (read-only)

3. Data model

BDD — allowed values

FieldTypeNotes
scenariosWrittenBystringThe three amigos (business, developer, tester) · The tester alone · The customer alone
writtenWhenstringBefore coding, in the specification workshop · After the release · During UAT
quadrantstringQ1 · Q2 · Q3 · Q4
stillNeededstringExploratory, usability and performance testing (Q3, Q4) · Nothing — BDD covers everything · Only more unit tests

4. Functional requirements

1. A1 A valid feature 3 marks

Requirements:

  • No undefined step, ≥ 6 scenarios each with a check, all passing on LabBook.

Must use: BDD

2. A2 Acceptance power 5 marks

Requirements:

  • Catch the faulty builds (6 listed, 2 hidden).

Must use: ATDD

3. B. BDD practice 2 marks

Requirements:

  • Four values.

Must use: testing quadrants

5. Element ids / classes used by the auto-grader

SelectorPurpose
FEATUREanswers/booking.feature.js
BDDanswers/bdd.js

6. Grading rubric

#FeatureMarks
1A1 A valid feature3
2A2 Acceptance power5
3B. BDD practice2
Total10

Common deductions

  • A “Then” with no action before it — it checks nothing.
  • Testing overlap only in the same lab — the rule says any lab.

7. Submission

Write your answers in the answer files on the right (they mirror the official template: one JavaScript object per test case / issue). Press Run for the visible checks and Submit for full grading, hidden checks included. Your score per question appears in the rubric table.
exercises.problemHtmlVi:
LabBook Project · Milestone 9 — BDD Acceptance Tests for Release 2.0

Dự án xuyên suốt · mốc cuối · acceptance test Gherkin chạy trên LabBook và bản build lỗi · 10 điểm

1. Tổng quan

Mốc cuối. Cho bản 2.0, ba người (nghiệp vụ, developer, tester) biến các luật đặt chỗ thành acceptance test chạy được bằng Gherkin. Developer đã viết sẵn định nghĩa bước (lib/steps.js, chỉ đọc); bạn viết FEATURE với các bước được hỗ trợ ở khối trên. Mỗi kịch bản bắt đầu từ dữ liệu mẫu LabBook; luật là các luật của API LabBook từ chương 2–8. A. Viết ít nhất 6 kịch bản; máy chấm chạy trên LabBook và 8 bản build lỗi (6 công khai, 2 ẩn). B. Mô tả cách làm BDD trong BDD.

Chức năng chính

  • A. Một feature Gherkin ít nhất 6 kịch bản, đạt trên LabBook và bắt được các bản build lỗi.
  • B. Ai, khi nào, góc nào, còn cần gì.

Yêu cầu chung

  • Viết hành vi mong đợi theo luật, không theo điều bạn nghĩ bản build đang làm.

2. Cấu trúc thư mục bắt buộc

answers/
├── booking.feature.js   ← const FEATURE = `Feature: … Scenario: … Given … When … Then …`
├── bdd.js               ← const BDD = { scenariosWrittenBy, writtenWhen, quadrant, stillNeeded }
lib/
└── steps.js             ← step definitions (read-only)

3. Mô hình dữ liệu

BDD — allowed values

TrườngKiểuGhi chú
scenariosWrittenBystringThe three amigos (business, developer, tester) · The tester alone · The customer alone
writtenWhenstringBefore coding, in the specification workshop · After the release · During UAT
quadrantstringQ1 · Q2 · Q3 · Q4
stillNeededstringnhư bản tiếng Anh

4. Yêu cầu chức năng

1. A1 Feature hợp lệ 3 điểm

Yêu cầu:

  • Không bước nào thiếu định nghĩa, ≥ 6 kịch bản đều có kiểm, đạt hết trên LabBook.

Bắt buộc dùng: BDD

2. A2 Sức bắt của acceptance test 5 điểm

Yêu cầu:

  • Bắt các bản build lỗi (6 công khai, 2 ẩn).

Bắt buộc dùng: ATDD

3. B. Cách làm BDD 2 điểm

Yêu cầu:

  • Bốn giá trị.

Bắt buộc dùng: testing quadrants

5. id / class máy chấm dùng

SelectorVai trò
FEATUREanswers/booking.feature.js
BDDanswers/bdd.js

6. Thang điểm

#Chức năngĐiểm
1A1 Feature hợp lệ3
2A2 Sức bắt của acceptance test5
3B. Cách làm BDD2
Tổng10

Lỗi hay bị trừ điểm

  • Bước “Then” không có hành động phía trước — không kiểm được gì.
  • Chỉ test trùng giờ trong cùng phòng — luật nói mọi phòng.

7. Nộp bài

Viết câu trả lời vào các tệp bên phải (giống template chính thức: mỗi test case / lỗi là một object JavaScript). Bấm Chạy thử để chạy kiểm hiện, Nộp để chấm đủ (kể cả kiểm ẩn). Điểm từng câu hiện trong bảng thang điểm.

solutionCodeJson.code:
// Acceptance tests of LabBook 2.0 (BDD, Gherkin).
const FEATURE = `Feature: LabBook booking rules (acceptance tests of release 2.0)

  Scenario: A student only sees her own bookings
    Given the seed data is loaded
    When student1 books LAB01 on 2026-11-04 at 9 for 1 hour
    Then the answer is 201 CONFIRMED
    When student2 lists her bookings
    Then the list contains 0 bookings

  Scenario: Two bookings at the same time are refused even in different labs
    Given the seed data is loaded
    When student1 books LAB01 on 2026-11-04 at 9 for 2 hours
    Then the answer is 201 CONFIRMED
    When student1 books LAB02 on 2026-11-04 at 10 for 1 hour
    Then the answer is 409 OVERLAP

  Scenario: The booking window is 14 days
    Given the clock is Monday 2026-11-02 08:00
    When student1 books LAB01 on 2026-11-16 at 9 for 1 hour
    Then the answer is 201 CONFIRMED
    When student1 books LAB01 on 2026-11-17 at 9 for 1 hour
    Then the answer is 422 OUT_OF_WINDOW

  Scenario: A locked student is logged out at once
    Given the seed data is loaded
    When student1 lists her bookings
    Then the answer is 200
    When the admin locks an@fpt.edu.vn
    And student1 lists her bookings
    Then the answer is 401 UNAUTHENTICATED

  Scenario: A booking that starts in less than 2 hours cannot be cancelled
    Given the clock is Monday 2026-11-02 08:00
    When student1 books LAB01 on 2026-11-02 at 9 for 1 hour
    Then the answer is 201 CONFIRMED
    When student1 cancels BK0001
    Then the answer is 409 TOO_LATE

  Scenario: Only a manager can close a lab
    Given the seed data is loaded
    When student1 closes LAB01
    Then the answer is 403 FORBIDDEN
    When manager closes LAB01
    Then the answer is 200

  Scenario: More than 6 hours a week is refused with a clear error
    Given the seed data is loaded
    When student1 books LAB01 on 2026-11-04 at 9 for 3 hours
    Then the answer is 201 CONFIRMED
    When student1 books LAB01 on 2026-11-05 at 9 for 3 hours
    Then the answer is 201 CONFIRMED
    When student1 books LAB01 on 2026-11-06 at 9 for 1 hour
    Then the answer is 422 WEEKLY_LIMIT

  Scenario: A re-opened lab accepts bookings again
    Given the seed data is loaded
    When manager opens LAB03
    Then the answer is 200
    When student1 books LAB03 on 2026-11-04 at 9 for 1 hour
    Then the answer is 201 CONFIRMED
`;

exercises.solutionExplanationHtml: Eight short scenarios, one per business rule, each with the allowed action and the refused one, catch every faulty build. They are Q2 tests (business-facing, supporting the team), written before coding by the three amigos; the team still needs Q3 and Q4 testing — exploratory, usability, performance and security.

Đây là test Q2 (hướng nghiệp vụ, hỗ trợ đội), viết trước khi code bởi ba người; đội vẫn cần Q3 và Q4 — khám phá, khả dụng, hiệu năng, bảo mật.

exercises.title: LabBook Interview corner 9 — Talking about Agile testing and your project
exercises.problemHtml:
Interview corner — final. You have tested LabBook from user stories to BDD acceptance tests. These questions are how interviewers check it — answer with your own project.

Requirements

  • Answer every question in the answer panel, then press Submit.
  • All answers must be correct to get Accepted; the explanations appear after you submit.
exercises.problemHtmlVi:
Góc phỏng vấn — cuối cùng. Bạn đã kiểm thử LabBook từ user story tới acceptance test BDD. Các câu này là cách người phỏng vấn kiểm chứng điều đó — trả lời bằng chính dự án của bạn.

Yêu cầu

  • Trả lời mọi câu trong khung trả lời rồi bấm Nộp.
  • Đúng hết mới được Accepted; giải thích từng câu hiện sau khi nộp.

solutionCodeJson.name: answers.md
solutionCodeJson.code:
# LabBook Interview corner 9 — Talking about Agile testing and your project — answer key

1. “What does a tester do in a Scrum team?”“Tester làm gì trong đội Scrum?”
   Answer: b) “Joins refinement to make stories testable, writes acceptance tests with the three amigos, automates regression in CI, explores each increment, reports status in the stand-up and improves the process in retrospectives.”
   The whole role, in one sentence, with verbs.VI: Cả vai trò trong một câu, bằng động từ.

2. “Walk me through a project you tested.”“Kể về một dự án bạn đã kiểm thử.”
   Answer: b) “LabBook, a lab-booking system: I reviewed the stories (found 11 requirement defects), designed EP/BVA/decision-table/state tests, wrote white-box and integration tests with mocks, ran system tests with Report 5.3, built a keyword and a BDD regression suite that caught every seeded faulty build.”
   Structure: context → what you did per level → measurable result.VI: Cấu trúc: bối cảnh → bạn làm gì ở từng cấp → kết quả đo được.

3. “What is BDD and when is it worth it?”“BDD là gì và khi nào đáng làm?”
   Answer: b) “Writing behaviour as Given/When/Then examples agreed before coding, then automating them — worth it when business rules are rich and misunderstandings are expensive; not for every small UI tweak.”
   Collaboration first, tool second; judgement about cost.VI: Cộng tác trước, công cụ sau; có cân nhắc chi phí.

4. “How do you know when a story is done?”“Làm sao biết một story đã xong?”
   Answer: b) “When it meets the Definition of Done: acceptance tests pass, code reviewed, unit tests and regression green in CI, no open critical defect, exploratory charter done.”
   Exit criteria of an Agile team.VI: Tiêu chí ra của đội Agile.

5. “What will you learn next as a tester?”“Tiếp theo bạn sẽ học gì về kiểm thử?”
   Answer: b) “Deeper automation (API and UI frameworks), performance and security testing, and the ISTQB Agile or Test Automation Engineer syllabus — the code of ethics calls it lifelong learning.”
   SELF — lifelong learning (lesson 1.5).VI: SELF — học suốt đời (bài 1.5).
